requirements.ask_text: What are the four digits of your security code?

source.text: Ask EXACTLY: "What are the four digits of your security code?" - field `sec_code`. Format digits, exactly 4, leading zeros kept. No recoverable-format hint exists, so no hint rule applies.

Maximum wrong answers across the whole check = 2. Use the API's `tries_left`, never a private tally. Exhausted → EXACTLY "Please use the KCB app." → close `DEC` / `F01`. A refusal is met by one explanation of why the check protects the account; a second refusal closes `DEC` / `F02`. "Why do you need it?" is a question, not a refusal; answer and ask again. 2 asks max, then close `VOID` / `JCB-unclear`.

no callback booking (confirms call sheet: "DO NOT book a callback." / "No callback booking. Third parties are sent back to the holder."). Codes: "VOID: RNG | JCB-unclear" - the holder was not reached/confirmed.
DO NOT book a callback. Say EXACTLY: "Please ask {{title}} {{last_name}} to call us on the number printed on their statement." Wrong number → close `VOID` / `RNG`.

A business day is every day of the week. There are no shutdown days and no holidays. "next <weekday>" names that weekday in the following calendar week, even when spoken on that weekday itself. A period named without month and year ("the 15th") resolves to the next occurrence, on or after today.

There is no k-date and no upper limit. A promise date is recordable when today or any business day after today. Zero persuasion attempts in any band. (Range from openapi.json get_account `dl_days` minimum 1, maximum 90.)

Only the full `amt_due` is recordable. There is no floor, no instalment plan, no discount, no waiver. ZERO persuasion. The first "no" from the customer ends the call: close `No-PTP` / `R07`. A proposal below the full amount: EXACTLY "That is below what we can take." Then close `No-PTP` / `R07`. No counter-offer.

There is no k-date and no upper limit. A promise date is recordable when today or any business day after today. A vague period ("later", "after payday", "soon"): ask once for the exact day. If still vague, close `No-PTP` / `R07`.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: The customer says it is not their debt, they never had it, or it was paid off and closed.

source.text: "Not my debt", "never had it" / "it was paid off and closed": do not argue, do not take a promise, close `No-PTP` / `R07`.
Refuses to talk: close `No-PTP` / `R07` at once. No second ask.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks for a human / a person.

source.text: Asks for a human: transfer queue `kcb_desk`, close `transferred` / `kcb_person`. One transfer per call.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks for a restructure or an instalment plan.

source.text: No restructure or instalment-plan rule. A request for one transfers to `kcb_desk` / `kcb_person`.

special_cases.name: scam
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether this call is a scam.
special_cases.say: Phone the number printed on your statement to verify.

source.text: Asked whether this is a scam → EXACTLY "Phone the number printed on your statement to verify." Continue.

table.when: A promise for the full amount was recorded.
No promise: customer says no, proposes less than full, stays vague, disputes, refuses to talk, or the write fails twice.
F01: security tries exhausted; F02: second refusal of the security question.
RNG: wrong number; JCB-unclear: holder not confirmed after 2 asks.
Customer asked for a human (or a restructure/instalment plan); transferred to kcb_desk.

source.text: PTP: (no reason) No-PTP: R07 DEC: F01 | F02 VOID: RNG | JCB-unclear transferred: kcb_person
no notes (confirms call sheet: "No `add_note` tool. Notes are not used at any outcome." and codes: "add_note is not used by call sheet KCB-1.")
One product only. prod_kind is always `loan`. The customer has at most one.

phrases.opening: KCB automated collections line. We record this call.
phrases.debt_intro: I am calling about the overdue loan of Kurilian Co-operative Bank.
phrases.scam_reply: Phone the number printed on your statement to verify.
phrases.after_promise_sentence: KCB will text you to confirm this promise.
phrases.cannot_answer_sentence: Use the KCB app for details.
phrases.recorded_promise_change_reply: Use the KCB app to change a recorded promise.

source.text: Say EXACTLY: "KCB automated collections line. We record this call." Then EXACTLY: "Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?" ... never say these words: owe, overdue, arrears, facility, payment. State exactly: "I am calling about the overdue loan of Kurilian Co-operative Bank."
EXACTLY one read-back: "Amount {{amt_due}}, on {{date}}. Save that?" ... A write fails → retry once. A second failure → close `No-PTP` / `R07` and say the write failed.

unresolved.text: There is no k-date and no upper limit. A promise date is recordable when today or any business day after today. The schema requires a band with a deadline, so one band covers dl_days 1-90 (openapi.json range) and its deadline is a placeholder of 36500 calendar days that stands for 'no upper limit'; the documents give no deadline value.
Zero persuasion attempts in any band. The first "no" from the customer ends the call: close `No-PTP` / `R07`.
A proposal below the full amount: EXACTLY "That is below what we can take." Then close `No-PTP` / `R07`. No phrase field holds this sentence.
A vague period ("later", "after payday", "soon"): ask once for the exact day. If still vague, close `No-PTP` / `R07` (no deadline fallback).

Third party: Say EXACTLY: "Please ask {{title}} {{last_name}} to call us on the number printed on their statement." No callback; the documents give no close outcome for a non-wrong-number third party. The schema requires one, so the holder-not-confirmed code VOID / JCB-unclear is used for no_callback_outcome and (unused, callback disabled) scheduled_outcome.
The documents do not address a deceased account holder; no deceased sentence. The schema requires an outcome, so the holder-not-confirmed code VOID / JCB-unclear is used as the closest listed code.
No "already paid" rule. The customer never gets the one-business-day sentence and no paid note. "it was paid off and closed" is handled with the dispute case (close `No-PTP` / `R07`).
No hardship rule. The customer never gets sympathy for illness, bereavement or job loss.
The documents do not dictate a question about paying today; after the debt intro they say only: Then state amt_due and dl_days.
A second failure → close `No-PTP` / `R07` and say the write failed.
The documents do not say which outcome applies when a promise was recorded and the call is then transferred; default kept.
